High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V)]] (Virtual Set 8, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 8/Light/Yavin 4 Massassi War Room.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FrvHtSkxzEm--ylJODSgRl5hsAfcfQPq/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Yavin 4 Massassi War Room.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,352 bytes, SHA-256 <code>6ebbcb60af15335ee36033c94cdabd5b86b7ace158d5b82cfb628bc0fd231e2c</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V8-L-yavin4massassiwarroom-2018-07-08.gif]]. This fan-project print-ready copy differs visibly from that official face in frame, copyright layout and host-label treatment. It is retained as a credited comparison, rather than identified as a high-resolution scan of that exact official image; it does not establish an additional official card version.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
